response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink WHERE ab.peercorr > 0.149 AND tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist), totals AS (SELECT ordertypedist, SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt FROM matched GROUP BY ordertypedist) SELECT m.translink, m.ordertypedist, m.cnt, CAST(m.cnt AS NUMERIC) / t.total_cnt AS fraction FROM matched m JOIN totals t ON t.ordertypedist = m.ordertypedist ORDER BY fraction DESC, m.translink, m.ordertypedist LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Each advancedbehavior row matches at most one transactionrecord, because transactionrecord.transreg is the primary key, so COUNT(*) per (translink, ordertypedist) equals the number of matched advanced behaviour records.
The denominator for each fraction is the sum of counts across all translink groups that share the same ordertypedist, after the peercorr filter and the NULL exclusion have been applied.
The request does not say how to order ties in the fraction, so ties are broken by translink and then ordertypedist to keep the output deterministic.
